jobs.description:

EDR Antwerp Shipyard is the largest shipyard in Belgium, specialised in ship maintenance and repairs, hull treatment and marine construction. Over 150 vessels annually are repaired and maintained at our shipyard in Antwerp, and projects are performed on board vessels across the world.
 

As a 
Crane Operator, you play a key role in ensuring safe, efficient and well organised lifting operations within and around our dry dock. You will primarily operate one of our 
five cranes and support a wide range of dockside activities that contribute directly to vessel repair and maintenance projects. You will join a close knit team of experienced crane operators where teamwork and safety are central.
 

RESPONSIBILITIES
 

• Operate one of the 
five cranes on site, including a Wolff tower crane, a Wolff luffing jib crane and three fully restored shipyard cranes with lifting capacities of up to 100 tonnes
 

• Carry out lifting operations safely and efficiently in accordance with site procedures and operational requirements
 

• Support signalling and guidance of lifting movements in areas with limited visibility or restricted access

• Identify, report and document damage, deviations and unsafe situations
 

• Support other operational activities on site when crane work is temporarily unavailable

• Good knowledge of English, which is the primary language used for operational communication, radio contact and coordination with subcontractors and vessel crews
 

• Knowledge of Dutch is an advantage for internal coordination and site instructions. Knowledge of Polish and/or Romanian is considered a strong asset
 

• Strong safety awareness and the ability to maintain oversight and prioritise effectively in a dynamic work environment
 

• Confident communicator with a practical and collaborative approach
 

• Hands on attitude and a consistent commitment to agreed procedures and safety standards
 

• Experience with crane operations, forklifts and/or mobile elevated work platforms is highly advantageous
